question: How much will Nvidia's stock price returns exceed Apple's in these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 7 - Sep 18)

calls.reasoning: Reference class first: 9-10 trading day NVDA-minus-AAPL return spreads in non-earnings windows, 2024-2026, center near 0pp with a wide, mildly left-skewed spread; I anchored there before news. Dispersion comes from options: NVDA IV 32.7% (1yr percentile 8) and AAPL IV ~25-27% with correlation ~0.45 imply a 5.5pp standard deviation over 9 sessions. The spread carries net beta ~+1.1 (NVDA 2.22 vs AAPL 1.09), so it is a levered long-market bet, not market-neutral: mid-September midterm-year seasonal weakness and a VIX at its 2026 low of 14.2 skew the left tail fatter, offsetting the small positive equity-risk-premium drift. Catalysts cut both ways and roughly cancel at the median: Apple's Sep 9 foldable/new-CEO event is a genuine two-sided binary (KeyBanc calls it a negative catalyst with a $250 target and foldable production problems already cost AAPL 2.51% on Sep 4, but bulls target $340-360), while NVDA has no scheduled catalyst after a ~9% post-earnings pop to near its 52-week high. No prediction market matches this contract; the Polymarket year-end market-cap-leader market (NVDA 61%) differs on horizon, instrument and metric, so I used it only as weak evidence. Escape mass is priced small but nonzero on both open bounds since 15pp is ~2.7 sigma and these spreads have fat tails.

calls.reasoning: Nine trading sessions (Sep 7 is Labor Day), no earnings for either name, so this is a two-sided volatility draw around a near-zero drift; dispersion, not direction, is the whole question. Median +0.5pp: NVDA's post-beat drift, the sell-the-news pattern into Apple launches, and a +1.1 net beta against positive expected market drift roughly offset midterm-September seasonality, NVDA's crowded-profit-taking setup 2.6% below its record after +14.7% in five weeks, and AAPL having already de-risked -2.51% on Sep 4. Width comes from reconciling option-implied vol (which needs an assumed correlation the current rotation regime contradicts) against the directly-measured realized spread vol, landing at SD ~6.7pp. Catalysts inside the window - Sep 9 Apple launch under a new CEO, FOMC plus dot plot Sep 15-16, quad witching Sep 18 - argue against compressing the tails off a VIX at its 2026 low. No prediction market prices this spread; the nearest books fail on instrument, deadline, and threshold.
calls.reconciliation: The runs agree on the median to within 0.3pp and disagree materially only on dispersion, which traces entirely to the correlation input: Run 1 assumed an implied rho of ~0.45 (SD 5.5pp, width 14.1), Runs 2 and 3 measured the spread directly over the last 25 ex-earnings sessions and got a daily spread SD of 2.6-3.0pp implying a slightly negative realized correlation (widths 15.6-17.2). Both are real. I settled it structurally rather than by averaging: a large share of AAPL's vol in THIS window is event-idiosyncratic (the Sep 9 launch), which mechanically depresses pairwise correlation below the multi-year +0.4-0.5, while a 25-session negative reading is a rotation artifact that will not persist. A beta decomposition (NVDA loading ~1.8-2.2, AAPL ~1.0, market vol ~13% annualized off VIX 14.2) gives rho~0.35 and SD 6.2pp; weighting up the directly-measured realized spread vol, which requires no correlation assumption at all, lands me at SD ~6.7pp, so I reject Run 1's width as too narrow and sit between Runs 3 and 2. Factually, I settled NVDA's FQ3 guide at $108B on the agreement of two independent runs, and accepted the unanimous 9-session count. Two factual disputes could not be settled without web access and I let them carry their uncertainty: the Sep 4-close vs Sep 8 baseline ambiguity (adds ~one session of noise, argues wider not different-centered) and the contradictory foldable production reports (the Sep 4 negative report is later and moved the stock, but it is single-sourced against an Aug 3 all-clear). On the center, no evidence breaks the tie - post-earnings drift plus sell-the-news plus a levered-long beta against midterm-September seasonality plus NVDA's crowded setup plus AAPL's completed de-risking - so I state it as judgment and take +0.5, the number I would bet. I carried forward Run 3's reference class (9-10 session spreads with no earnings inside) but conditioned it on the 2026 regime, since Run 2's 2023-2026 class mean of ~+2.0pp/window is contaminated by NVDA's 15x compounding, a regime that has demonstrably stopped now that both names are within ~3pp YTD. Escape mass sits at 2.15 sigma with concrete mechanisms on both sides, tilted slightly upward for the higher-vol name's convexity. I retrieved nothing myself this run, so sources is empty.
